item.title: v0.2.0
item.description:
v0.2.0 — Customizable file types

  • Preferences window for managing the file-type list.
  • 8 built-in presets (.txt, .md, .json, .sh, .env, .html, .py, .js) plus user-defined extensions.
  • Per-type starter templates, drag-to-reorder, optional submenu mode.
  • App Group misconfig warning.
  • Native SF Symbol toolbar icon.
